title: Contract Clauses: Agreeing and Undertaking
grammar: Recap: official register in a contract
goal: I can write the key clauses of a contract (*megállapodnak*, *kötelezettséget vállal*).
I can say what counts as performance and what forms part of the contract (*teljesítés*, *elválaszthatatlan részét képezi*).
I can say that one invalid point does not make the whole contract invalid (*érvénytelenségi záradék*).

sections.title: Unit 10: Contractual Precision, Ambiguity & Negotiation Register
body: This unit is about contracts and negotiation: the clauses of a contract, a polite counter-offer, limits on liability, the organs of a company, and a text about honour and the given word.
The reading in lesson 5 is a text about the writer Márai Sándor.
